interpretations: Media type rate is computed as SUM(Bytes)/SUM(Milliseconds) per media type, and the "simple average" is the mean of those per-type rates across all media types.
Media type rate is computed as the average of per-track Bytes/Milliseconds within each media type, and the overall figure is the mean of those per-type rates.
Media type rate is computed as AVG(Bytes)/AVG(Milliseconds) per media type.
"All media types" means only media types that have at least one track (a media type with no tracks has no rate).
"All media types" means every row in MediaType, with tracks-less types contributing a NULL or zero rate.
"Counting only tracks that have a media type" means an inner join between Track and MediaType, which drops tracks with no matching media type. MediaTypeId is NOT NULL, so this may drop nothing.
Tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded from the rate calculation and from the track count.
Tracks with NULL Bytes are included in the track count but excluded from the rate.
Media types are grouped by MediaType.Name rather than MediaTypeId, so types sharing a name merge.
Media types are grouped by MediaTypeId, with the name only used for display.
"Their average number of tracks" is the mean, across the above-average media types, of each type's track count.
"Their average number of tracks" is the mean count of tracks per media type, where the count includes only tracks with non-NULL Bytes.
"Their average rate" is the simple mean of the qualifying media types' rates (each type weighted equally).
"Their average rate" is the pooled rate over all tracks in the qualifying media types, i.e. total Bytes divided by total Milliseconds.
"Average margin above that overall average" is the mean of (type rate − overall average rate) across the qualifying types.
"Average margin above that overall average" is the mean of the percentage or ratio margin ((type rate − overall) / overall) across the qualifying types.
"Above" is a strict inequality (>), so types equal to the average are excluded.
"Above" is inclusive (>=), so types equal to the average are included.
"Unrounded" means no ROUND or formatting is applied to the three output columns.
The output is one row with three columns: average rate, average track count, and average margin.
The overall average is computed once over all media types, not recomputed within the qualifying subset.
The overall average is computed from the unfiltered set of all media types, but with tracks lacking Bytes dropped before the per-type rates are computed.
Missing interpretations:
The overall average is the mean of per-type rates computed over all individual tracks (a track-weighted average, not a per-media-type mean).
The overall average is the pooled rate, SUM(Bytes)/SUM(Milliseconds) over all tracks, rather than a mean of per-type rates.
"Average margin above that overall average" is the mean of the qualifying types' rates minus the overall average, taken as a single difference.
"Average margin above that overall average" is the mean of the qualifying types' rates divided by the overall average, taken as a single ratio.
"Average number of tracks" counts tracks per media type by distinct TrackId.
Tracks with Milliseconds equal to 0 are excluded to avoid division by zero in per-track rates.
The media type "name" grouping treats NULL names as a single group, or excludes them.
The "simple average" is the unweighted mean over media types after the per-type rates are rounded or cast to integers, with integer division in SQLite truncating the rates.
queries: SELECT AVG(rate) FROM (SELECT SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId);
SELECT m.Name, AVG(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / AVG(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track INNER JOIN MediaType ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId
